title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary:
Implemented the forms technology stack and flow Generate mode:

- **forms/core** (`@semio-tech/forms-core`): FormSpec/FormStep/FormQuestion types, QUESTION_KIND_CATALOGUE, parseFormSpec, FormRuntime, FormEditOp + applyFormEditOp, in-file vitest (6 tests).
- **ui/react**: Field primitive, Catalogue palette + catalogueTreeDragController, cross-container tree reorder (dropPosition, resolveTreeDropPosition, treeReorderDragController, useTreeReorder), extended tree handleDrop, in-file vitest for reorder/catalogue helpers.
- **forms/react** (`@semio-tech/forms-react`): FormRenderer, FormBuilder, FlowGenerateSurface, flowFixtureToFormSpec, applyGenerationValuesToFixture (9 tests).
- **forms/fixture**: default.forms.json + onboarding.forms.json exercising all question kinds, steps, conditions, validation.
- **forms/play** (`@semio-tech/forms-play`): Builder + Preview windows, FormsPlayController, fixture catalog, vitest (12 tests). Dev server verified at http://127.0.0.1:6058/ (HTTP 200).
- **flow Generate mode**: generateMode on FlowPlayController with generations CRUD, worker evaluation via lazy FlowOrchestratorClient, FlowPlayGenerateSurfaceHost, shared runGenerationCommand/evaluateGenerationFixture.
- **procedural 2d/3d**: inherit Generate mode with Procedural*GenerateSurfaceHost and generation commands.
- **Registration**: root workspaces/scripts, script.ts routing, PLAYGROUND_PORTS (6058/6059), launch.json dev:forms, framework renderer ./forms export + bootFormsPlay, platform core forms surface kinds.

Tests run: forms-core, forms-react, forms-play, flow-play (52+ tests including generate mode). Runtime: forms play dev server confirmed.
